basis.file25_plan: Complete Public UI, Profile Timeline and Visual Experience — Final Harmonized Specification 2.0 plus governing addenda
basis.central_plan: Sabri Social Homeopathy Platform Definitive/Consolidated Governing Master Plan 2026
basis.method: Fresh twenty-scope plan-to-code and cross-file audit focused on administrator configuration truth, runtime observability of settings, timeline defaults, optional provider enablement and current companion ownership.

reviews.finding: Baseline main 2d02c93356b050313e30e29aeceb57080771c2a5 and exact main CI run 1638 were verified as repository/CI evidence only.
File 25 remains bounded public visual/profile/timeline presentation; no second shell, profile master, publication backend, security center or global search backend was introduced.

Several administrator preferences were visible but had no runtime effect: timeline_provider_mode, accessibility_mode, cache_ttl, safe_mode_controls and diagnostics_enabled. Removed false configurability, kept mandatory accessibility/Safe Mode/diagnostics always available, and grouped the control center by the File 25 plan sections.

responsive_preview offered tablet although the governed View-as-Public contract exposes mobile/desktop responsive modes. Removed the unsupported tablet preference so every selectable value has a real preview destination.

The renderer fabricated avatar_alt for the Completion Assistant whenever an avatar existed, preventing the required missing-alt-text finding. Assistant evidence now stays bound to canonical File 03 alt metadata; the public renderer may still use an accessible descriptive fallback.

The plan allows a default filter but no governed setting existed. Added bounded default_timeline_filter and apply it only when it matches the current approved filter registry; unknown values fail to All.
The public hero already provides a deterministic initials fallback when canonical avatar media is absent without inventing third-party media.

The plan allows optional provider enablement but built-in optional section providers were always registered. Added a bounded allowlist preference, including explicit disable-all, and File 25 now registers each optional provider only when enabled.
Current File 03 main/contract remains compatible with the corrected URL/alt/focal public media DTO consumer; no File 03 table/private-ID dependency was reintroduced.
File 08 remains clinic/appointment owner; Appointment remains hidden without an authoritative profile-user booking destination contract.
File 17 remains relationships/messaging owner; Follow remains hidden without a target-bound owner destination and Message remains bounded to a concrete File 03 public projection URL.
File 20 remains structural shell/admin parent owner; File 25 control sections stay nested under compatible File 20 with degraded standalone fallback only.
File 21 remains publication/ProfileTimeline owner; File 25 retains read-only federated timeline presentation and optional rebuild state only.
File 22 Composer and File 23 private Publishing Dashboard remain native owners; File 25 exposes only guarded canonical destinations.
File 24 remains assurance/governance owner; File 25 mandatory accessibility/Safe Mode/diagnostics controls cannot be weakened by presentation preferences.
File 26 remains global search/discovery/ranking owner; File 25 default filter and search remain profile-local presentation only.
REST preferences remain strict allowlisted/versioned with bounded values; removed preference keys are rejected as unknown rather than silently creating dead controls.

Accessibility remains mandatory; profile responses remain no-store until an accepted cache-partition contract exists; Safe Mode and diagnostics remain recovery/operations features rather than disableable presentation flags.
Source/readme/dependency/review metadata still described Reviews 635-654 as latest. Advanced lineage through Reviews 655-674 while keeping mutable exact-head CI and all staging/live gates external.
Current relevant companion repository heads were rechecked; repository source completion is separate from Hostinger staging, deployed package, live DB/schema, migration and operational truth.

corrections.admin_truth: Removed dead/no-op presentation preferences and grouped controls by the governed File 25 admin sections.

corrections.optional_providers: Added bounded enabled_optional_providers with explicit disable-all and runtime registration enforcement.
corrections.status_truth: Advanced source/release lineage without self-certifying current-head CI or staging/live acceptance.
